goal: A project can register a local repository, create WorkItem branches, commit through a changeset, open and merge a pull request with approval, and inspect the related code in a Code View
scenarios: developer registers a local repository on a project
developer creates a named branch linked to a WorkItem
a changeset is committed with the WorkItem id in the message
push and pull request still require human approval
Code View shows branches, commits, diffs, files, and pull requests
constraints: core operation does not require GitHub
protected branch names cannot be created
agent push, pull request, and merge still need C1 approval
nonGoals: hosted GitHub, Gitea, or GitLab write adapters
